title: About Us
content:
# About Hawaiian Vacation Rents

Hawaiian Vacation Rents is a specialized listing directory built for one purpose: connecting travelers directly with homeowners across Oahu, Maui, Kauai, and the Big Island.

## Why We Built This

Vacation rental platforms have become complex, expensive, and opaque. Booking fees layer on top of service fees on top of cleaning fees, and by the time a traveler confirms a reservation, the price bears little resemblance to what was advertised. Owners, meanwhile, pay substantial commissions on every booking — sometimes 15 to 20 percent — and surrender control over their guest relationships, pricing policies, and calendar.

We thought there was a better way.

## How It Works

Hawaiian Vacation Rents is an advertising venue, not a booking platform. Owners publish their listings — complete with photos, descriptions, pricing, house rules, and contact information — and guests reach out to them directly. There is no booking engine, no payment processing, and no commission taken from any transaction.

**For owners:** A listing on Hawaiian Vacation Rents costs $5 for 30 days, renewable for $5. That is it. No commissions. No percentage of your rental income. No surprise fees. You communicate directly with your guests, handle your own agreements, and keep every dollar of your rental revenue.

**For travelers:** You browse listings, find properties that match your needs, and contact owners directly. You negotiate, review the rental agreement, and arrange payment entirely between yourselves. We do not intermediate the transaction in any way.

## Our Coverage

We list properties on all four main Hawaiian islands:

- **Oahu** — from Waikiki condos to North Shore beach houses
- **Maui** — resort-area homes, Upcountry retreats, and everything in between
- **Kauai** — North Shore hideaways, South Shore cottages, and Princeville condos
- **Big Island** — Kona Coast vacation homes, Hilo side bungalows, and Kohala properties

## Our Commitment to Transparency

We encourage all owners to include their Hawaii State TAT license number and county permit number in their listings. We encourage all travelers to ask for and verify those numbers before making any payment. Hawaii has regulations governing vacation rentals, and operating within those regulations is the right thing to do.

We do not verify the accuracy of listings ourselves — we are a directory, not an inspection service. Our disclaimer page explains this honestly and in detail.

## Get In Touch

Questions about the platform, help with your listing, or anything else: reach us at hello@hawaiianvacationrents.com. We are a small team and we read every message.

title: Privacy Policy
content:
# Privacy Policy

**Last updated: July 2026**

Hawaiian Vacation Rents ("we," "us," or "our") operates hawaiianvacationrents.com. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have.

## Information We Collect

### Account Information
When you create an owner account, we collect your name, email address, and any profile information you choose to provide.

### Listing Content
Owners submit listing content including property descriptions, photos, pricing, availability, house rules, and contact information. **Contact information that owners choose to include in their listings — such as a phone number or email address — is displayed publicly on those listings.** Owners control what contact information appears and are responsible for the accuracy of everything they publish.

### Payment Information
Listing fees are processed by our payment providers — PayPal, or a direct USDT (TRC20) transfer on the Tron blockchain. We do not receive, store, or have access to your full credit card number, CVV, or other sensitive payment credentials. PayPal handles card payment security under its own PCI-DSS compliance, and USDT payments settle directly on the blockchain — we never see or store card numbers or wallet keys. We retain records of transaction amounts and dates for accounting purposes.

### Usage and Analytics
We use standard web analytics tools to understand how visitors use our site — pages visited, time spent, referral sources, and general geographic regions. This data is aggregated and not linked to individual identities.

### Cookies
We use cookies for session management (keeping you logged in) and for analytics. You may disable cookies in your browser settings, though this may affect site functionality.

## How We Use Your Information

- To operate and maintain owner accounts
- To display listings to travelers
- To process listing fee payments via PayPal
- To send you transactional emails (receipt confirmations, listing expiration reminders)
- To improve the platform based on aggregate usage data

We do not sell your personal information. We do not share your information with third parties except as required to operate the service (PayPal for payments, analytics providers) or as required by law.

## Data Retention

We retain account information for as long as your account is active. If you close your account, we will delete or anonymize your personal data within 90 days, except where we are required to retain records for legal or tax purposes.

## Your Rights

You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information at any time by contacting us at privacy@hawaiianvacationrents.com. We will respond within 30 days.

## Security

We use industry-standard security measures including HTTPS encryption for all data in transit. No method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

## Contact

Privacy questions or requests: privacy@hawaiianvacationrents.com

*This document is a general template and does not constitute legal advice.*

# Terms of Service

**Last updated: July 2026**

These Terms of Service govern your use of hawaiianvacationrents.com (the "Site"), operated by Hawaiian Vacation Rents ("we," "us," or "our"). By using the Site, you agree to these terms.

## Nature of the Platform

Hawaiian Vacation Rents is an **advertising venue only**. We provide a directory where property owners can publish vacation rental listings and travelers can discover those listings and contact owners directly.

**We are not a party to any rental transaction.** We do not process payments between guests and owners, we do not hold deposits, we do not issue booking confirmations, and we do not intermediate any aspect of the guest-owner relationship. All negotiations, agreements, and payments occur solely between guests and owners.

## Owner Responsibilities

Owners who publish listings on this Site represent and warrant that:

- All listing information is accurate, current, and not misleading
- They hold all required permits and licenses to operate a short-term rental in Hawaii, including a valid Hawaii Department of Taxation Transient Accommodations Tax (TAT) license and any applicable county permit (Oahu Bed and Breakfast or Transient Vacation Unit permit; Maui, Kauai, or Hawaii County short-term rental registration)
- They are solely responsible for collecting and remitting Hawaii General Excise Tax (GET) and Transient Accommodations Tax (TAT) on rental income, in compliance with all applicable state and county laws
- They have the legal right to rent the property they list
- Their listings do not violate any third-party rights, including homeowner association rules or condominium bylaws that may restrict short-term rentals

Violation of these representations may result in immediate removal of the listing without refund.

## Listing Fees and Renewal

- The listing fee is **$5.00 for a 30-day listing period**, payable at the time of publication
- Listing fees are **non-refundable** once a listing has been published
- Listings expire automatically at the end of the 30-day period; renewal requires payment of an additional $5.00
- We reserve the right to adjust pricing with reasonable notice

## Prohibited Content

Listings and user content may not include false or misleading information, content that violates any law, harassment or discriminatory content, or listings for properties that are not legally permitted for short-term rental use.

## Our Right to Remove Listings

We reserve the right to remove any listing, at any time, at our sole discretion, for any reason, including but not limited to violation of these Terms or receipt of complaints about a listing. Removal does not entitle the owner to a refund of any listing fee.

## Limitation of Liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, Hawaiian Vacation Rents shall not be liable for any damages arising from the use of this Site or from any rental transaction between a guest and an owner. We expressly disclaim any liability for the accuracy of listings, the conduct of owners or guests, the condition of any property, or the outcome of any rental arrangement.

## Disclaimers

The Site is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. We do not verify the accuracy of listings, the identity of owners, or the legal status of any property.

## Changes to These Terms

We may update these Terms at any time. Continued use of the Site after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

## Contact

hello@hawaiianvacationrents.com

title: Disclaimer
content:
# Disclaimer

**Last updated: July 2026**

## We Do Not Verify Listings

Hawaiian Vacation Rents is a listing directory. We publish advertising content submitted by property owners and we do not independently verify the accuracy of any listing, the identity of any owner, the legal status of any property, or the condition of any accommodation.

Travelers must exercise their own due diligence before entering into any rental agreement or sending any money to anyone.

## Safe Direct Booking Practices

Renting a vacation home directly from an owner is a rewarding way to travel — but it requires care. We recommend the following practices for every direct rental transaction:

### Before You Commit

- **Request a video tour.** A live or recorded video tour with the owner on camera, showing the actual property, is one of the best safeguards against fraudulent listings.
- **Verify the rental license.** Ask the owner for their Hawaii State TAT (Transient Accommodations Tax) license number and any applicable county short-term rental permit number. Verify these through official Hawaii government websites — the Hawaii Department of Taxation and your county's planning or permitting department.
- **Research the address.** Confirm the property exists using Google Maps Street View and cross-reference the listing photos against what appears online.
- **Request a written rental agreement** before making any payment. A legitimate owner will provide one. Review it carefully before signing.
- **Do not pay by wire transfer, gift cards, or cryptocurrency.** These payment methods offer no recourse if something goes wrong. Credit cards and Venmo/PayPal Goods and Services offer buyer protections.

### Red Flags

- Prices significantly below comparable listings in the area
- Owner claims to be overseas or otherwise unable to show the property in person
- Pressure to pay quickly or to bypass a rental agreement
- Communication that moves immediately off-platform to encrypted messaging apps
- Photos that appear in reverse-image searches on other listing platforms or under different property names

## No Liability for Transactions

Hawaiian Vacation Rents is not a party to any transaction between a guest and a property owner. We do not process payments, hold deposits, or guarantee any accommodation. We are not responsible for and expressly disclaim all liability for any loss, harm, or dispute arising from a vacation rental transaction facilitated or advertised through this Site.

## External Links

This Site may contain links to external websites for reference purposes. We do not control, endorse, or take responsibility for the content, privacy practices, or accuracy of any third-party website. Links are provided for convenience only.

## Contact

If you have a concern about a specific listing, contact us at hello@hawaiianvacationrents.com and we will review it.
